paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Inilah usadha brahma, pengobatan untuk rasa menusuk/menyengatnya, pemulihannya. Jika ada penyakit brahma, terasa nyeri menusuk, bagian tubuh yang sakit/terasa kaku, terasa panas, brahma sindu, cara pemulihan dan penanganan rasa menyengatnya, rasa patah-patah/remuknya, penanganan bagian tubuh yang sakit // Jika brahma rupa pada bagian tertentu... sawan mas, pemulihannya...
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
This is the usadha brahma, treatment for its stinging/sharp pain, its recovery. If there is brahma disease, stinging sharp pain, affected areas feeling stiff/painful, hot sensation, brahma sindu, recovery and treatment of stinging pain, broken/crushed aches, treatment for affected body parts // If brahma rupa occurs... sawan mas, recovery...
